column2: Whenever you discard one or more cards, exile the top card of your library. You may play that card until your next end step.: a writer for the Rule effect (MayPlay of the exiled card until your next end step) in a triggered ability; the first ability now reads whole (every sentence after "When you do" is the reflexive trigger)
A pre-game reveal and exile of a drafted card; no draft happens in the engine, so the card stays inert
Contraptions: a Contraption deck, assembling, and a ReplaceWhen for a Rigger assembling a Contraption (CR 905)
A land type granted while a mire counter remains, and a delayed trigger for the rest of the game that removes the counters this artifact put (objects linked across zones, CR 607)

ReplaceBy::PayOrGraveyard whose cost counts the spell's X (ExileFromGraveyard of X creature cards; Price::announced gives up on an unannounced X) and a counter kind chosen per paid card (+2/+0, +1/+1 or +0/+2) put as it enters

Three rules for noncreature artifacts you control while this is untapped: can't be enchanted (Aura targets and attach legality, attached Auras stay, CR 303.4), indestructible, and other players can't gain control (control-change effects of others skip them)
Linked exile that notes the counters of the exiled creature and its attached Auras, returning them with the noted counters and attached (CR 607)
Cards exiled face down with the source, turned face up by an effect, and countering every spell with the same name as one of them
A characteristic: the equipped creature has all names of nonlegendary creature cards (CR 201.2 name set; Pred::Named matching any such name)
Exile a spell with delay counters and put it back on the stack as a copy of the original when the last is removed (spell state kept in exile)
Conjure by Oracle name from a fixed list with a once-per-name memory, and a cast permission for the copy
